qa_pairs.question: What is the condition for continuing an Open OnDemand session at a later time?
How strictly were resource limits enforced on the decommissioned JupyterHub?
qa_pairs.answer: Limits on JupyterHub were not implemented very strictly, so you could temporarily exceed these.

qa_pairs.question: When must users request resource limits for an Open OnDemand application?
qa_pairs.answer: Limits need to be requested before starting an application.
